name: What types of bathtub faucets can you repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathtub faucets can you repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: We repair a wide range of bathtub faucet types, including compression, cartridge, ceramic disc, and ball faucets. Our experienced technicians are familiar with various brands and configurations, from single-handle to widespread two-handle models. When you contact CG Plumbing Solutions, providing details about your faucet type, such as single-handle or two-handle, can help our technicians prepare with the right tools and potential replacement parts, speeding up the repair process.
acceptedAnswer.description: We repair various bathtub faucet types including compression, cartridge, ceramic disc, and ball faucets across many brands.
